standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the exact sequence in which H^q(X, F) sits between H^q(X, F_1) and H^q(X, F_2), which is the entire mechanism of the proof.

core_obligations: Apply the long exact sequence of etale cohomology to 0 -> F_1 -> F -> F_2 -> 0 (proof line 16007): the exactness gives H^q(X, F) as an extension of a submodule of a quotient of the finite Lambda-modules H^q(X, F_i) in the range q = deg.
Conclude H^q(X, F) is a finite Lambda-module (proof line 16007): intermediate terms of finite modules in the LES are finite over the Noetherian ring Lambda.
proof_roadmap: Feed the short exact sequence into the long exact cohomology sequence.
Read off from the LES that H^q(X, F) is an extension/subquotient of the two finite Lambda-modules H^q(X, F_1), H^q(X, F_2).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts finite-generation of middle cohomology from that of the two ends (statement lines 15996-16004). The proof is the one line (proof lines 16006-16008) that H^q(X, F) sits in the long exact sequence between H^q(X, F_1) and H^q(X, F_2), both finite Lambda-modules, and over the Noetherian ring Lambda an extension of finite modules is finite. H2: a single standard application of the long exact sequence on finite modules.
